origin.description: AO-marked exterior doorway at the drawing-bottom east stair lobby on floor 1.

alignment.method: Identity alignment of matching page geometry; north/south stair shafts and central elevator shaft coincide across floors.

metadata.nodeConvention: Room nodes are visible doorways. Additional nodes retain circulation bends, junctions and transfer approaches.
metadata.distanceConvention: Euclidean feet from rounded endpoint positions; weight 1. No vertical-distance override. Aligned transfers may have zero distance; stair effort and elevator waiting are omitted.
metadata.accessibility: Omitted means unknown. Only source-marked AO entrance edges are true; stairs are false. No accessibility or current access certification.
metadata.digitization: Manual inspection of dated vector-outline PDF; two-pixel-per-PDF-point inspection coordinates converted using x=(pixelX-710)/3.6, y=(1364-pixelY)/3.6. Approximate, not surveyed.
uncertainties: Auditorium 170 refers to sheet 1, which is not supplied. Lower auditorium doorway and western descending access are retained as separate destinations; no speculative route through seating/stage is added.
Stairs west of courtyard are marked DN only on floor 1; no corresponding upper-floor transfer is invented.
Auditorium east stairs appear only on floor 1 and are not extended to floors 2 or 3.
Room 129/129B is divided by a folding partition; no through-room shortcut is assumed.
Room 172 is inside the auditorium boundary; its internal stage access cannot be completed without referenced sheet 1, so it is omitted rather than linked through the outer wall.

The north and south bridge stair runs span the passage; no same-floor corridor crosses either flight. The south east-facing exit and its landing form a separate two-node component. Their connection through the stair core cannot be resolved from this sheet without inventing a same-floor bypass or landing correspondence.
